description.mn: Al Haramain Amber Oud Bleu Edition: Unisex хув үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: бэрсүүт жүрж, ягаан чинжүү, гаа, нимбэг; зүрхний ноот: ветивер, цагаан гаа, жасмин; суурь ноот: зандан мод, пачули, хүж, хуш мод.
description.en: Amber Oud Bleu Edition by Al Haramain Perfumes is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Amber Oud Bleu Edition was launched in 2022. Top notes are Grapefruit, Pink Pepper, Mint and Lemon; middle notes are Vetiver, Ginger and Jasmine; base notes are Sandalwood, Patchouli, Olibanum and Cedar.
